video_title: LIVE: Pelicans vs. Nuggets Pregame w/ Jamahl Mosley 11/14/2026

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on managing Eve Missi's minutes
quotes.excerpt: It's more about when than anything and I'll keep testing him and seeing how he feels

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: It sounds like Eve Missi is doing a lot better tonight too. How are you planning to utilize him this evening?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: As best as we can. There would be a minutes restriction with him just to make sure. It's more about when than anything and I'll keep testing him and seeing how he feels throughout the game.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says Eve Missi will be on a minutes restriction tonight as he returns to the lineup. The team is monitoring how he feels throughout the game.

structured.context: Coach Jamahl Mosley discusses the minutes restriction for Eve Missi as he returns from injury.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley provides update on Trey Murphy's recovery
quotes.excerpt: He's just responding back to treatment well and to his rehabilitation process

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: How about Trey Murphy? An update on him?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: No update today. He's responding back to treatment well and to his rehabilitation process. He's been responding well but just not to the point where he's able to get on the court and go yet.

quotes.social_post: No update on Trey Murphy today. Jamahl Mosley says he is responding well to treatment but is not yet ready to return to the court.

structured.context: Coach Jamahl Mosley provides an update on the rehabilitation process for Trey Murphy.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on defensive strategy against Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray
quotes.excerpt: The two-man game is obviously something we just got finished with our walk-through

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Third time you played Denver, obviously no real surprises here. Trying to get a hold of the two-man game with Murray and Jokic?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: They've added some pieces. Cam didn't play against us last time, the last couple times, and him being back gives them another shooting threat that we've got to make sure we take care of. But the two-man game is obviously something we just got finished with our walk-through and the ability to cover them the right way and mix up coverages and what we're willing to take away and what we're wanting to take away and then what we're willing to live with with those two.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley on facing the Nuggets: The focus is on mixing up coverages against the Jokic and Murray two-man game while keeping an eye on the shooting threats around them.

structured.context: Coach Jamahl Mosley explains the defensive strategy for handling the two-man game between Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Eve Missi's defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: His ability to be the low man coming across the lane protecting, being able to guard Jokic

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: In what ways can Eve Missi help y'all out just by being out there?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: More than anything and what we've been missing a little bit of is rim protection. We talked about those straight-line drives last night and guys getting to the rim. His ability to be the low man coming across the lane protecting, being able to guard Jokic in different areas and using his length and his basketball IQ is going to definitely help us out in a lot of ways tonight.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley says Eve Missi will provide much needed rim protection tonight, noting his ability to be the low man and use his length to guard Jokic.

structured.context: Coach Jamahl Mosley explains how Eve Missi will provide rim protection against the Nuggets.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley declines to discuss Dejounte Murray's future
quotes.excerpt: Speculation of things is not where I'm suited to go

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified reporter
text_blocks.text: About Dejounte, do you think he's played his last game with the Pelicans?

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: We put out the statements the other day and that's what I'm going to continue to rely upon. Speculation of things is not where I'm suited to go and so I'll leave it at what the statements were and then let the parties that are handling it handle it the correct way and I'll continue to focus on our locker room and the games that we have coming up throughout this week.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley declined to comment on the future of Dejounte Murray, stating he will rely on previous team statements and focus on the games ahead.

structured.context: Coach Jamahl Mosley declines to comment on speculation regarding the future of Dejounte Murray.

quotes.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
quotes.summary_phrase: Jamahl Mosley on Saddiq Bey's impact and professionalism
quotes.excerpt: His professionalism, his consistency, his toughness, his focus to the attention to details

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified speaker
text_blocks.text: Saddiq with a 30-point game last night, first Pelicans player this season to do so. Regardless if he's coming off the bench or starting, he's always seemed to make the impact. Just talk about what he's meant to the team so far this season.

text_blocks.speaker: Jamahl Mosley
text_blocks.text: I can't say enough about Saddiq. His professionalism, his consistency, his toughness, his focus to the attention to details, just the little things he does for our team is huge. Just because guys know they can rely on him night in and night out. You know what you're going to get from him every single night. Not going to say much, but he's going to bring that lunch pail and go to work every night and that's what we appreciate about him and our guys definitely have so much love for the way that he approaches the game and just the way he is with them.

quotes.social_post: Jamahl Mosley praised Saddiq Bey for his consistency and professionalism, calling him a guy who brings his lunch pail to work every single night.

structured.context: Coach Jamahl Mosley praises the professionalism and consistency of Saddiq Bey.
